name: Reinoso de Cerrato (Spain)
description: A hoist third of three squares, white with a black cauldron, black with a white Maltese cross and white with a black cauldron, the fly red charged with the crowned municipal arms of Reinoso de Cerrato (cauldrons and a cross on white and black above ears of wheat on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Reinoso de Cerrato; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: cauldrons on the white squares and the black central square
Maltese cross on the black square
Reinoso de Cerrato arms — cauldrons and cross on white and black above ears of wheat on yellow
yellow field and crown of the arms
